guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.278 to 18.47 (+6545%, z=+589), by far the strongest deviation in the digest. Its latency-90 and latency-50 also rose (z=+82 and +58), while the other services' latencies stayed flat, and memory (+13.7%, z=+2.7) and sockets (+2.9%) barely moved, which points to CPU rather than mem or socket.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate the emailservice process for runaway CPU use (e.g. a hot loop or a stuck worker), then restart the affected pod or scale out replicas and apply a CPU limit. This is non-destructive and reversible.
